### 2. Scope of services

Own strategy/analysis. BCA adviser coordinates departures; system/passive/structure/facade designers detail; contractors install/test; authorities decide. Scoped FEIR is not occupation approval.
Report unsupported solutions/alternatives; no approval guarantee. Operator accepts staffing/maintenance/storage/use limits. Revision-controlled plans/registers trace solutions to designer/verification.
Fire basis: Confirm parts/classes/compartments/height, occupants/hazards/systems, accepted solutions, current instruments/verification owner, authority route, insurer targets and revisions.

I = included; O = optional price; X = excluded; ? = scope unknown. Resolve unknown scope before issue; propose departures in R6.

### 4. Allowances

Counts by solution/stage, unit/duration; fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate. Authorised assumptions need owner/date/consequence/review point.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Solution schedule | 2 solution IDs: part/extent, departure, method/criteria, revision/dependencies/package; distinguish grouped subissues |
| Analysis / modelling | 2 scenarios per solution/method; sensitivities, iterations/alternatives, checks and change unit |
| Issues / consultation | 2 issues per report; team/authority rounds, workshops/duration, updates; package author/submitter/applicant/payer, response end |
| Evidence / access | 2 areas/visits/hours; tests/openings by location, access/shutdown/reinstatement owner; inaccessible-work options |
| Tender / construction | 2 packages/cycles; RFI hours, hold-point visits/duration, dates/notice/response, abortive/out-of-hours basis |
| Verification | 2 completion stages; certificates/scripts, witness sessions/duration, retests/reports, defect endpoint |
| Other options | 2 interim phases/specialist/peer rounds; advisory cutoff/post-contract period; services-review extent/meetings |

### 5. Terms

- Attached Project fire engineering agreement (attached), scope/fees, addenda and written acceptance govern; settle precedence/commencement. RFP does not authorise work.
- Written authority before scope/allowance/ceiling/rate/fee/program changes: reason, work, basis, time and solution/approval/occupation impacts.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; normal coordination/development and defined rounds included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Payment 30 days from correct milestone invoices. R6 declares inspection prepayment, release restrictions, interest/recovery/suspension or shorter terms; verify statutory requirements.
- State rates/hold period/escalation; extras/disbursements require prior authority.
- Validity 90 days from closing; ex GST/GST/total, base/options separate.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23.
- Issue numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree team/authority/operator project/maintenance/future-use rights, third-party reliance, native models/licences/retention/handover. Confidentiality permits authorised/lawful disclosure; marketing needs consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notice/cure/suspension/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts. Insurance is not a cap; disclose conflicts, agree team changes.
